items.summary: Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private and approve preparation of a written Woot permission request, without sending it or changing the gate. Woot's public terms do not establish rights for commercial public display, caching, derivatives, or alerts; security, accuracy, legal, and attribution gates remain incomplete. The CFO confirms that Amazon commission was $4.92 on 2026-09-21, while site-level margin, ROI, payback, and forecasts remain unsupported. Prepare the request for review only and retain the private gate.

Recommendation: run three bounded, report-only SEO evidence tasks for xxxtea.com, marineactivity.com, and aliencouncil.com while preserving existing implementation and measurement work. Evidence: the 30-day SEO window shows 87 shared impressions across five xxxtea pages, 239 impressions at position 8.3 for marineactivity.com, and 77 impressions at position 5.5 for aliencouncil.com. Site-level revenue, margin, and ROI are not calculable because Amazon attribution is incomplete and one tracking ID remains unmapped; the main unknown is whether these pages can gain qualified clicks or conversions without harming existing rankings. Smallest next step: capture baselines and return one reversible recommendation per site with guardrails, a sample threshold, and rollback. Owner question: should SearchWoot remain private, or should we prepare a written Woot permission request for your approval? Options: keep private; prepare permission request.
